h1: Modern Resort Phichit — a small, newer resort with clean rooms and parking at your door
intro: If you want somewhere quiet in Phichit with clean rooms and no long walk from your car, Modern Resort Phichit is a place real guests speak well of — a small 16-room resort built in 2019 in Khlong Khachen, on the main road in the Mueang Phichit area. body.html: Modern Resort is a small resort in the Khlong Khachen area of Mueang Phichit. The thing real reviews mention most consistently is that the rooms are clean and the atmosphere is quiet and private — it's a single-storey resort where you park right outside your door, so there's no dragging luggage far. The resort was built new in 2019 and has just 16 rooms, so it never feels crowded. It suits travellers who want a calm place to sleep after a day on the road, or anyone in town for errands who wants to rest somewhere low-key.

Rooms are standard, with both Double and King bed options. Each has air-con, a flat-screen TV, a kettle, a fridge, drinking water, a desk and a hot shower. Guests say the in-room amenities are about what you'd expect at this level and the place keeps things clean. Rates start at around ฿700 and climb to roughly ฿1,000-plus on busy dates — a reasonable resort price for Phichit.

The parking is another thing guests praise often — you park right beside your room, which is genuinely handy if you've driven in: easy to unload, and reassuring for your car. The resort sits in a quiet semi-suburban area, about 1 km from Wat Mun Lek and close to Phichit Provincial Stadium. The town centre and market are a little way out, a few minutes by car, so this place works better for people with their own vehicle than for those who want to walk everywhere.
"The resort is quite private, the rooms are clean, the service is good and the price is affordable. It's quiet, easy to get to, and you can park right beside your room. Overall it's good."

To be straight about the weak points — the bathrooms are fairly small and could sometimes be cleaner, and the rooms themselves aren't large; they're compact, as you'd expect at a small resort. Some guests found the mattresses a bit firm, so if you like a soft bed, be prepared. Breakfast is offered but it's simple, with limited choices, and one review noted the breakfast count didn't match the booking — worth confirming the number of breakfasts with the property at check-in.

One more thing to know: this is a small resort with just 16 rooms, so it fills up fast over holidays and long weekends — book ahead if you're coming then. And as a suburban-style resort it has no big facilities like a pool or gym; it's about a clean, quiet place to sleep rather than a full-service stay. If you'd rather be central and able to walk to the market, The Nest Hotel or Phichit Plaza might suit you better.

Overall, Modern Resort scores around 8 out of 10, with guests mainly praising the cleanliness, the quiet, and parking at your door. It isn't luxurious and the rooms aren't spacious, and the small-bathroom and breakfast niggles are real. But if you've driven into Phichit and want a newer, clean, quiet room with easy parking for upper-hundreds to low-thousands of baht, this little resort does its job well.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Modern Resort Phichit

faq.q: Where is Modern Resort Phichit, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Modern Resort sits at 113 Moo 8, Khlong Khachen Subdistrict, Mueang Phichit District, on the main road in a suburban area. It's about 1 km from Wat Mun Lek and close to Phichit Provincial Stadium, roughly 10 minutes by car from the town market. Driving in yourself is the easiest way to get there.

faq.q: How much does Modern Resort Phichit cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿700/night for a standard double or king room. On holidays and long weekends prices climb to roughly ฿1,000-plus. Rooms include air-con, a flat-screen TV, kettle, fridge and drinking water. Always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Modern Resort Phichit have parking?
faq.a: Yes — it's a single-storey resort where you park right outside your room, for free. It's easy to unload and reassuring for your car, and it's one of the things real guests praise most. Ideal for self-drivers.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Modern Resort Phichit clean, and what are they like?
faq.a: Real reviews praise cleanliness first of all — it's a small resort built new in 2019, well kept, with the basics covered. That said, the rooms and bathrooms are fairly compact, and some guests find the mattresses firm, so if you want a large room or a soft bed, keep that in mind.

faq.q: Does Modern Resort Phichit serve breakfast?
faq.a: It offers a simple breakfast with limited choices. One review noted the breakfast count didn't match the booking, so it's worth confirming with the property at check-in how many breakfasts are included to avoid confusion in the morning.

faq.q: Who is Modern Resort Phichit best for?
faq.a: It's best for self-drivers who want a newer, clean, quiet room with easy parking. The private setting is genuinely restful. But because it's suburban and small, if you'd rather be central and walk to the market, look at The Nest Hotel or Phichit Plaza instead.
